**Changed since 2026-10-30, the scenario:** on 2026-11-12 the PM amended F081: sign up by mobile number (1, 9, 11-16), the line and look (#1271; 5, 6, 10), the safety line (17), make-or-support moved to the waitlist (6), plus a zip-gated order (18). The criteria went from nine to eighteen. **The code has not followed:** sign-up is still email then code with a required legal name, the phone step is a stub that refuses only non-fixed VoIP and is off until the Twilio keys (#707), and none of the anti-bot layers exists. The only new build is the waitlist journey (#1321, F076), which carries the soft and police lines (17, waitlist half) and asks the plan once (6). Criteria 2, 3, 4, 7 and 8a are untouched and still checked. The old checks for 1, 5, 6 and 9 assert the old wording and no longer count. Criterion 6's wording on 'what they plan to do' appears in criterion 1 as well as 6; read together, it is asked once, on the waitlist, and carried forward.

**Filed today:** #1403 (check 15), #1404 (check 6), #1405 (criterion 16, needs-pm). Every other gap already had an open Issue: #1280 (1, 18), #1289 (9, 11), #1291 (12-14), #1293 (17), #1271 (5, 10), #849 (8b).
